lessons.title: 17.1 Stimulus-response pathway
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain stimulus-response pathway and relate its structure or mechanism to biological function.

A receptor detects a stimulus, sensory pathways carry information to the CNS, integration occurs, and motor pathways activate effectors.

**Apply your learning:** Use a labelled diagram, sequence or comparison to explain the concept. Consider how a change in one component affects the whole biological system.

explanations.ur: ریسیپٹر محرک محسوس کرتا ہے، حسی راستے معلومات مرکزی اعصابی نظام تک پہنچاتے ہیں، وہاں تجزیہ ہوتا ہے اور حرکی راستے اثرانداز اعضا کو فعال کرتے ہیں۔
explanations.sd: ريسپٽر محرڪ محسوس ڪري ٿو، حسي رستا ڄاڻ CNS تائين کڻن ٿا، اتي تجزيو ٿئي ٿو ۽ حرڪتي رستا اثر ڪندڙ عضوا فعال ڪن ٿا.

lessons.title: 17.2 Neurons and reflexes
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain neurons and reflexes and relate its structure or mechanism to biological function.

Neurons have dendrites, a cell body and an axon; reflex arcs produce rapid, often involuntary responses to stimuli.

**Apply your learning:** Use a labelled diagram, sequence or comparison to explain the concept. Consider how a change in one component affects the whole biological system.

lessons.title: 17.3 Nerve impulse and synapse
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain nerve impulse and synapse and relate its structure or mechanism to biological function.

Action potentials depend on ion movements across membranes; synapses transfer signals chemically or electrically between cells.

**Apply your learning:** Use a labelled diagram, sequence or comparison to explain the concept. Consider how a change in one component affects the whole biological system.

lessons.title: 17.4 Central and peripheral nervous systems
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain central and peripheral nervous systems and relate its structure or mechanism to biological function.

The brain and spinal cord form the CNS; cranial and spinal nerves form the PNS, including autonomic pathways controlling internal organs.

**Apply your learning:** Use a labelled diagram, sequence or comparison to explain the concept. Consider how a change in one component affects the whole biological system.

explanations.ur: دماغ اور حرام مغز مرکزی اعصابی نظام بناتے ہیں؛ دماغی و نخاعی اعصاب محیطی نظام بناتے ہیں، جس میں خودکار اعصابی راستے بھی شامل ہیں۔

lessons.title: 17.5 Drugs, disorders and diagnosis
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain drugs, disorders and diagnosis and relate its structure or mechanism to biological function.

Psychoactive substances alter neural signalling; neurological disorders have diverse causes and may be investigated using EEG, CT or MRI.

**Apply your learning:** Use a labelled diagram, sequence or comparison to explain the concept. Consider how a change in one component affects the whole biological system.

explanations.ur: نفسیاتی اثر رکھنے والے مادے اعصابی پیغام رسانی بدلتے ہیں؛ اعصابی بیماریوں کی جانچ EEG، CT یا MRI سے کی جا سکتی ہے۔
